$schema-note: Tier 2 of the design brief (2026-08-27) §3.1. Theme meaning. Tier 3, Tailwind, and components read these.
$color-note: Every color token is mode-scoped (brief §3.3) and every name ends in -rgb, because the value is a space-separated RGB triple. Four ops resolve a color: themeKey takes the light value from config/theme.colors and derives the dark value with deriveDarkColors (packages/shared/src/theme.cjs); alias points at another token and emits var(); rule computes a rule weight from the mode's ink and surface; primitive takes fixed channels from primitives.json.
$text-note: The fluid editorial scale, brief §3.7. Eight steps, no more: a preset may retune a step, a preset never adds one. The middle term of each clamp() carries the step from its small anchor to its large anchor between a 375px and a 1440px viewport.
$space-note: Brief §3.7. The gap between groups is at least twice the gap inside one (interface guidelines, Layout): xs pairs with md, sm with lg, md with xl.
$rule-note: Brief §3.7. Rules are structure, so each weight ships as a color plus a width. The colors are mode-scoped above; the widths do not change with the mode.
$font-note: Roles, never family names (brief §3.2). The three live roles — heading, body, data — plus mono for figures, timestamps, and code, all resolve from config/theme.fonts through the bundled-set allowlist (spec §7.4). A role config/theme.fonts does not name falls through to the alias list below instead: --font-accent is the retired role, kept for one release; --font-data follows the body face; --font-mono follows the data face until a mono ships in PR2.
$motion-note: Brief §2.2. Functional motion runs 120ms to 200ms. One expressive signature per surface finishes under 600ms.
$weight-note: Named weights so a component never writes a raw number.
